newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Netherlands in investment agreement with Tunisia.
newsitem.headline: Netherlands in investment agreement with Tunisia.

text.p: The Netherlands and Tunisia have reached agreement on an investment protection pact, the Dutch ministry of economic affairs said on Wednesday.
"The investment protection agreement aims at promoting mutual investments and offers Dutch investors in Tunisia better investment guarantees," the ministry said.

Dutch junior economic affairs minister Anneke van Dok is currently visiting Tunisia where she is holding talks with several government officials. Van Dok is accompanied by a trade mission with representatives of several Dutch companies.
